description: This file defines a class CppWrapperCpuArrayRef which provides methods for generating C++ code for tensor operations optimized for CPU using ArrayRef tensors in the PyTorch code generation framework. It includes code for memory planning, buffer management, kernel invocation, tensor reinterpretation, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: CppWrapperCpuArrayRef
classes.description: Generates C++ code for running on CPU with Tensor representations as ArrayRef, including methods for code generation, buffer management, kernel invocation, and fallback handling.

methods.description: Returns the C++ type for a given input tensor or sympy expression.

methods.description: Generates code to assert the number of elements in tensor inputs.

methods.description: Creates code to reuse or reinterpret existing buffers for new ones.

methods.description: Checks that it is safe to borrow an ArrayRef tensor as a regular tensor.

methods.description: Returns whether it is safe to borrow ArrayRef tensors as regular tensors safely.

methods.name: None generate_c_shim_extern_kernel_call( self, kernel: str, args: list[str], device: str, **_ )
